neighbours.label: first name of a U.S. legislator right after the title Sen. / Rep. / Senator (strongest for Rob, Bob, Robert, Joe)
fire: The hearing was chaired by Sen. Bob Corker of Tennessee.
A letter signed by Rep. Rob Bishop of Utah was sent to the agency.
Reporters waited outside for Sen. Robert Casey of Pennsylvania.
The compromise was drafted by Senator Joe Lieberman over the weekend.
The veterans group thanked former Sen. Bob Dole for his support.
During the speech, Rep. Joe Wilson of South Carolina shouted from his seat.
The farm bill was backed by Sen. Rob Johnson and three colleagues.
An amendment from Rep. Robert Aderholt of Alabama passed on a voice vote.
quiet: The meeting was chaired by coach Bob Corker of the tennis club.
A letter signed by the plumber Rob Bishop was sent to the landlord.
Reporters waited outside for the singer Robert Casey after the show.
The recipe was drafted by chef Joe Lieberman over the weekend.
The veterans group thanked the comedian Bob Dole for his jokes.
During the speech, my cousin Joe Wilson shouted from his seat.
The farm was bought by a dentist named Johnson and three colleagues.
A painting from the artist Robert Aderholt sold at a small auction.
